basics.name: Eisen Hower Oallesma
basics.summary: Detail-oriented Computer Science graduate with hands-on experience building web applications, designing database systems, and managing technical projects. Skilled in Java, Python, C/C++, and full-stack web development, with a strong foundation in IT support and customer-facing operations.

highlights: Provide hospitality service by greeting guests warmly and ensuring their needs are met to provide a pleasant atmosphere for all customers.
Assist the server staff by expediting beverage orders and helping with table turnover to provide efficient dining service during rush hours.
Maintain high standards of sanitation by performing hourly safety checks and ensuring that logs and supplies are up-to-date and compliant with regulations.
Ensure a clean and efficient working environment while multitasking between order preparation, facility cleaning, and proactive restocking duties.
Completed inventory logistics duties such as receiving shipments, checking supply lists, and organizing heavy inventory to ensure availability for immediate use.
Handled order presentation for drive-thru and register, accurately processing complex order customizations and beverage preparing during rush hours.
